ambient_projection_no_go.finite_diagnostics: Any finite collection of homogeneous continuous linear functionals leaves a nonzero 1-eigenvector in their common kernel.
ambient_projection_no_go.scope: This is an ambient L^2/finite-rank no-go; atomic self-convolution profiles are a stricter nonlinear class.
ambient_projection_no_go.spectrum: P_(E_v) is an orthogonal projection with norm exactly one and infinite-dimensional 1-eigenspace.

claim_boundary: This artifact proves the exact actual-Farey signed pair-sum PSD form, the norm-one unrestricted Fourier-projection boundary including finite homogeneous continuous linear diagnostics, an equal-weight actual-cell phase-lattice extremizer satisfying the CRR cardinality/separation/energy band, and a one-cell inverse lattice lemma. It proves neither Base-admissibility of that extremizer, F4F_eta on Base, AFARI, CFARI, CRR-U, a Base-compatible counterexample, a cubic estimate, a density gain, a short-interval theorem, a full-method saturation theorem, nor an L-function result.

crr_u_effect.statement: CRR-U remains open. The result sharpens only the energy-only signed F4F boundary.

constants.finite_diagnostic_scope: finite homogeneous continuous linear functionals on unrestricted L^2(R)

one_cell_inverse.endpoint: The phase-lattice extremizer has epsilon=0 at its actual alpha_Q.
one_cell_inverse.statement: If |R_W(alpha)|>=(1-epsilon)|W|, then for 0<lambda<=pi at most pi^2*epsilon*|W|/(2lambda^2) rows lie angular distance more than lambda from one phase-lattice coset modulo 2*pi/|log(alpha)|.

phase_lattice_extremizer.conclusion: F4F_eta fails on the energy/spaced/cardinality class for every fixed eta>0 along an unbounded even sequence; this is not a disproof on the full Base class.
phase_lattice_extremizer.properties: W_Q subset [0,H], |W_Q|=R, W_Q is H^(1/100)-separated, and v^(20-delta(v))<=E(W_Q)<=v^(20+delta(v)) eventually
phase_lattice_extremizer.row_set: W_Q={P_Q a:a in A}, P_Q=2*pi/log(s_Q/r_Q), with A obtained by the sealed random-subset/deletion argument

remaining_gate.statement: A signed F4F advance must exploit nonlinear equal-weight atomic self-convolution realizability and/or the common Base coefficient vector to exclude or control the phase-lattice profiles; generic PSD and finite-dimensional spectral data cannot do so.

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: exact Fourier/projection algebra, integer scale and random-subset constants, source-artifact checks, replay, and tamper rejection

signed_pair_sum_form.labels: K_v retains every actual coprime ordered Farey label and true bounded logarithmic jitter
signed_pair_sum_form.positivity: K_v is positive semidefinite despite the signed S_Q expansion.
signed_pair_sum_form.statement: For nu_W=(sum_(t in W)delta_t)*(sum_(t in W)delta_t), I4_log(W)=<nu_W,K_v nu_W>=integral_(log U_v)|nu_hat_W(x)|^2dx, with K_v(s,s')=J_H(s-s')S_Q(s-s').

source_context.actual_labels: coprime ordered (r,s) in the frozen Q-shell with true |theta|<=3 jitter
